lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: communicating a complete and checkable argument
lessonRef.title: Performance task build: communicating a complete and checkable argument

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Set up the first two carefully; the rest of the build depends on them.

items.prompt: In a parallelogram, one angle measures 79°. Find the consecutive angle.
In a triangle, a segment joins the midpoints of two sides. The third side measures 16. Find the length of the midsegment and state its relationship to the third side.
choices: 32, and it is parallel to the third side
16, and it is parallel to the third side
8, and it is perpendicular to the third side
8, and it is parallel to the third side

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A proof concludes that base angles of an isosceles triangle are congruent, after constructing the bisector of the apex angle. Which statement supplies the missing justification?
choices: The two smaller triangles are congruent by SAS, so their corresponding base angles are congruent.
All triangles have congruent base angles.
The bisector is perpendicular to the base by definition.
The base angles look equal in the diagram.

items.prompt: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. One angle measures 126°. Find the measure of the corresponding angle.
In a triangle, the two remote interior angles measure 32° and 60°. Find the exterior angle at the third vertex.
In a parallelogram, one angle measures 147°. Find the opposite angle.
In a triangle, a segment joins the midpoints of two sides. The third side measures 36. Find the length of the midsegment and state its relationship to the third side.
choices: 72, and it is parallel to the third side
18, and it is perpendicular to the third side
36, and it is parallel to the third side
18, and it is parallel to the third side

items.prompt: A proof concludes that vertical angles are congruent. Which statement supplies the missing justification?
choices: Vertical angles are congruent by definition.
The angles are congruent because they are opposite in position.
Each vertical angle is supplementary to the same adjacent angle, so both have the same measure.
The two lines are parallel, forcing the angles to match.

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Carry the build to a result and state the check that would catch an error in it.

items.prompt: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. One angle measures 155°. Find the measure of the alternate interior angle.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: In a triangle, the two remote interior angles measure 70° and 50°. Find the exterior angle at the third vertex.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
